use_cases: Toggle between light and dark themes in application headers or navigation bars
Quick user preference toggle in settings panels
Theme switching control in dashboard interfaces
Universal dark/light mode switch for any SaaS application
ai_summary: A minimalist theme switch button component featuring glass-morphism styling with backdrop blur effects and smooth gradient transitions. Supports light/dark mode toggling via next-themes, with hover states that enhance visual feedback through subtle gradient overlays. Includes customizable sizes (sm/default/lg) and optional labels, making it ideal for headers, navigation bars, or settings panels across any SaaS or web application.
